name: @interest-protocol/blast-partner-client
description: Environment-agnostic TypeScript client for BLAST partner REST reads

scripts.build: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src test scripts examples
scripts.format:check: biome format src test scripts examples
scripts.lint: biome lint src test scripts examples
scripts.check:package: npm run build && publint --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:package
